item.text:
{
  "packet_id": "H7-T03-1",
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim_id": "C001",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "Recorded order dates provide calendar anchors for customer histories.",
      "scope": "Calendar placement of the histories used in the inquiry.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P002"}],
      "ambiguity": "The reliability of individual recorded dates is not established here."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C002",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "Recalled customer events may have uncertain dates.",
      "scope": "Reconstructed histories in the consenting sample.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P002"}],
      "ambiguity": "The extent of date uncertainty is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C003",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "Recalled customer histories may omit episodes.",
      "scope": "Reconstructed histories in the consenting sample.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P002"}],
      "ambiguity": "No particular omission is established."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C004",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "Recalled customer histories may contain unusual quantities.",
      "scope": "Reconstructed histories in the consenting sample.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P002"}],
      "ambiguity": "Unusual quantities could describe actual variation or problems in reconstruction; the mapping does not specify."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C005",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "Shared service conditions might produce recurring temporal patterns across customer histories.",
      "scope": "A possible basis for comparing overlapping histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P004"}],
      "ambiguity": "Neither the existence nor the strength of such patterns is established."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C006",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "Comparable consumption across households is not established.",
      "scope": "Cross-household temporal comparisons.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P004"}],
      "ambiguity": "This does not establish that consumption is incomparable."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C007",
      "fields": ["state"],
      "proposition": "A common household response to shared service conditions is not established.",
      "scope": "Cross-household temporal comparisons.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P004"}],
      "ambiguity": "This does not establish that responses necessarily differ."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C008",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Unknown intervals must remain represented as unknown in reconstructed histories.",
      "scope": "Construction and comparison of household event sequences.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P008"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C009",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Reported customer events must be distinguished from recorded orders.",
      "scope": "The evidential basis of reconstructed histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P008"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not specify a general reliability ranking for all reported and recorded information."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C010",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Alignment may shift only uncertain recalled segments, and only within their reported date ranges.",
      "scope": "Permissible adjustments when comparing overlapping histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P009"}],
      "ambiguity": "Treatment of recollections without a reported date range is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C011",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Known order dates must remain fixed during alignment.",
      "scope": "Permissible adjustments to household histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P010"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C012",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Alignment must preserve event order.",
      "scope": "Permissible adjustments to household histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P010"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not specify how to handle uncertainty about event order itself."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C013",
      "fields": ["operation", "signal"],
      "proposition": "A candidate alignment should permissibly and repeatedly match distinctive ordered sequences across several independently anchored histories while making previously inconsistent timing intelligible.",
      "scope": "The proposed alignment signal, before a finding has been established.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P009"}, {"source_id": "P018"}],
      "ambiguity": "Distinctiveness, repetition, independence and sufficient correspondence have no specified thresholds."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C014",
      "fields": ["operation", "signal"],
      "proposition": "Alternative alignments must be compared and competing fits recorded rather than selecting an alignment for convenience.",
      "scope": "Assessment of candidate alignments.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P010"}, {"source_id": "P019"}],
      "ambiguity": "No formal comparison criterion is specified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C015",
      "fields": ["operation", "signal"],
      "proposition": "Low stock followed by unsuccessful collection and a later or delayed order, recurring around the same service conditions, is a proposed sequence against which uncertain collection recollections can be tested.",
      "scope": "An illustrative candidate observation, not an established customer pattern.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P011"}, {"source_id": "P020"}, {"source_id": "P021"}],
      "ambiguity": "A later order is not necessarily delayed relative to household need; the two formulations do not establish an expected purchase interval."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C016",
      "fields": ["signal"],
      "proposition": "Continued stock availability without a refill attempt is another proposed candidate signal.",
      "scope": "An illustrative observation to seek, not a finding.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P020"}, {"source_id": "P021"}],
      "ambiguity": "Its interpretation for any particular household remains to be established."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C017",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Time since first order and time since reported depletion should supplement, without replacing, calendar-date comparisons.",
      "scope": "Temporal comparison of participating household histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P012"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not specify how disagreements between these temporal comparisons should be resolved."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C018",
      "fields": ["operation", "signal"],
      "proposition": "An apparent missing or anomalous episode is a question for corroboration rather than an established fact; a mismatch suggesting an omission calls for clarification through an already agreed follow-up.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of inconsistencies in reconstructed histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P013"}, {"source_id": "P022"}],
      "ambiguity": "The required form or strength of corroboration is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C019",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "An event must not be inserted merely to improve an alignment.",
      "scope": "Revision of reconstructed histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P013"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C020",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Alignment should stop if alternative alignments remain equally plausible.",
      "scope": "An epistemic stopping condition for the first-week inquiry.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P014"}],
      "ambiguity": "Equal plausibility has no specified assessment rule."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C021",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Alignment should stop if overlap is insufficient.",
      "scope": "An epistemic stopping condition for the first-week inquiry.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P014"}],
      "ambiguity": "The minimum sufficient overlap is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C022",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Alignment must stop when the first week ends.",
      "scope": "The operational time bound on the alignment inquiry.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P014"}],
      "ambiguity": "This deadline does not imply that an explanation will have been discriminated."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C023",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "If a recurring, corroborated sequence identifies an actionable fulfillment or communication obstacle, choose one corresponding process change for the remaining month.",
      "scope": "Conditional selection of the bounded intervention.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P015"}],
      "ambiguity": "The thresholds for corroboration, identification and actionability are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C024",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Where the recurring, corroborated evidence identifies confusion as an actionable obstacle, clearer refill instructions are a proposed corresponding process change.",
      "scope": "An illustrative intervention under the selection condition in P015.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P015"}],
      "ambiguity": "The example does not establish that clearer instructions will resolve the confusion."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C025",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Where the recurring, corroborated evidence identifies access difficulty as an actionable obstacle, a feasible collection-hours adjustment is a proposed corresponding process change.",
      "scope": "An illustrative intervention under the selection condition in P015.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P015"}],
      "ambiguity": "Feasibility is unspecified, and the example does not establish that the adjustment will resolve the difficulty."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C026",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "The selected process change should have its intended observable effect specified in advance.",
      "scope": "Evaluation of the month-long trial.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P016"}],
      "ambiguity": "No particular effect size or success threshold is specified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C027",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Where feasible, eligible customers or collection periods should be randomly allocated between the changed process and the current process.",
      "scope": "The proposed comparison design for the bounded trial.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P016"}],
      "ambiguity": "The allocation unit and feasibility criteria are left open; random allocation is not asserted to have occurred."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C028",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "If no explanation is sufficiently discriminated, the team should refrain from choosing a purported remedy.",
      "scope": "The decision branch following an inconclusive inquiry.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P017"}],
      "ambiguity": "Sufficient discrimination is not defined."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C029",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "If no explanation is sufficiently discriminated, the purchasing deadline should still be met with a cautious, explicitly uncertain commitment based on confirmed orders and reported stock needs.",
      "scope": "Purchasing under unresolved explanatory uncertainty.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P017"}],
      "ambiguity": "No quantitative rule for a cautious commitment is supplied."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C030",
      "fields": ["signal"],
      "proposition": "Trial observation should include the specifically targeted step, such as successful collection or correct refilling, alongside remaining stock, attempted purchases and dated orders.",
      "scope": "The proposed evidence collected during the process trial.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P023"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not equate success at the targeted step with a later repeat purchase."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C031",
      "fields": ["signal"],
      "proposition": "Participation must be recorded separately from outcomes.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of inquiry and trial records.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P024"}],
      "ambiguity": "The particular participation measures are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C032",
      "fields": ["signal"],
      "proposition": "Missing follow-up must be recorded separately from outcomes.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of inquiry and trial records.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P024"}],
      "ambiguity": "No method for handling missing outcomes is specified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C033",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "A distinctive, independently corroborated alignment can narrow the calendar position of uncertain customer events.",
      "scope": "Temporal inference from a qualifying alignment.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P025"}],
      "ambiguity": "The achievable precision and corroboration threshold are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C034",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "A distinctive, independently corroborated alignment can check reconstructed customer histories.",
      "scope": "Assessment of histories participating in the alignment.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P025"}],
      "ambiguity": "Checking a history is not specified to establish every event in it."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C035",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "A distinctive, independently corroborated alignment can connect overlapping observation periods.",
      "scope": "Temporal linkage across supported overlaps.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P025"}],
      "ambiguity": "The extent of the resulting connection is unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C036",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Such an alignment can distinguish some households that have not yet needed a refill from households whose need preceded a documented obstacle.",
      "scope": "Some households with sufficiently informative, corroborated histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P025"}, {"source_id": "P026"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not claim exhaustive classification or specify how refill need is established in every case."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C037",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Repeated correspondence supports prioritizing a mechanism for a bounded trial.",
      "scope": "Mechanism prioritization following comparison of customer histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P027"}],
      "ambiguity": "No ranking rule or evidential threshold is specified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C038",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Repeated correspondence does not establish that the prioritized mechanism explains the overall repeat-purchase decline.",
      "scope": "The population-level explanatory reach of the alignment evidence.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P027"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C039",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "A credible comparison during the month can support a provisional decision about the changed process within the tested group and conditions.",
      "scope": "The decision supported by the bounded process trial.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P028"}],
      "ambiguity": "Credibility is not operationally defined, and no decision outside the tested group and conditions is established."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C040",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "At five weeks, the purchasing commitment should draw on confirmed demand, observed stock and usage information, trial results and explicit uncertainty.",
      "scope": "The purchasing decision at its stated deadline.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P029"}],
      "ambiguity": "The weighting of these inputs and the commitment quantity are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C041",
      "fields": ["inference"],
      "proposition": "Any later observation used to assess second orders should be consented, and assessment should occur once the relevant cohorts have actually completed eight weeks.",
      "scope": "Later assessment of the eight-week second-order outcome.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P030"}],
      "ambiguity": "Availability of later consented observation is not assured."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C042",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Household size, usage, initial quantity, alternative purchasing and local service events can disrupt shared temporal patterns.",
      "scope": "Limits on correspondence across household histories.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P031"}],
      "ambiguity": "The listed disruptions are not assigned separate effects, magnitudes or demonstrated occurrence."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C043",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Short or repetitive sequences can create false matches.",
      "scope": "Reliability of candidate alignments.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P032"}],
      "ambiguity": "No minimum length or distinctiveness threshold is supplied."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C044",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Recall and measurement errors can create false matches.",
      "scope": "Reliability of candidate alignments.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P032"}],
      "ambiguity": "Neither the frequency nor the magnitude of these errors is established."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C045",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Incorrect calendar anchors can create false matches.",
      "scope": "Reliability of candidate alignments.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P032"}],
      "ambiguity": "No particular anchor is identified as incorrect."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C046",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Insufficient overlap can create false matches.",
      "scope": "Reliability of candidate alignments.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P032"}],
      "ambiguity": "Sufficient overlap is not quantified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C047",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Searching many relative shifts can create false matches.",
      "scope": "Reliability of the alignment search.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P032"}],
      "ambiguity": "No search limit or correction procedure is specified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C048",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Precise event dates must not be claimed when the evidence supports only a range.",
      "scope": "Precision of temporal conclusions.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P033"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C049",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "A reconstructed chronology must not be extended beyond supported overlaps.",
      "scope": "Temporal reach of the reconstructed history.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P033"}],
      "ambiguity": "The criteria for a supported overlap are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C050",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Because promotions and new collection points began in the same quarter, matching timing alone cannot separate their effects.",
      "scope": "Attribution of effects to these concurrent changes.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P034"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not claim that their effects are inseparable using other evidence."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C051",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Voluntary participants may differ from other customers.",
      "scope": "Representativeness of the follow-up sample.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P035"}],
      "ambiguity": "The direction and magnitude of any differences are unknown."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C052",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Customers who send support messages may differ from other customers.",
      "scope": "Representativeness of support-message evidence.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P035"}],
      "ambiguity": "The direction and magnitude of any differences are unknown."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C053",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Complaint frequency does not directly measure satisfaction.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of customer-support evidence.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P035"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not deny that complaints can contain relevant information about particular experiences."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C054",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Customer silence does not directly measure satisfaction.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of customers sending no message.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P035"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C055",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Nonpurchase does not directly measure satisfaction.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of missing repeat orders.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P035"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C056",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "A month's trial cannot establish eight-week repeat purchase for newly exposed customers.",
      "scope": "Outcome claims available from the month-long trial.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P036"}],
      "ambiguity": "The limitation is explicitly about newly exposed customers."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C057",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Small comparisons may remain inconclusive.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of the bounded trial.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P036"}],
      "ambiguity": "No sample-size threshold is specified, and inconclusiveness is possible rather than inevitable."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C058",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Nonrandom comparisons may remain inconclusive.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of the bounded trial.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P036"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not assert that every nonrandom comparison is inconclusive."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C059",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "If the trial creates observed fulfillment problems, it should be stopped or revised.",
      "scope": "A conditional operational bound during the trial.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P037"}],
      "ambiguity": "The threshold for a fulfillment problem and the choice between stopping and revising are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C060",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "If the trial cannot be delivered as specified, it should be stopped or revised.",
      "scope": "A conditional operational bound during the trial.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P037"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not specify which delivery failures require stopping rather than revision."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C061",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Departures from the specified trial must be documented before outcomes are interpreted.",
      "scope": "Interpretation of trial evidence after implementation departures.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P037"}],
      "ambiguity": "Documentation is required, but its effect on the interpretation is not prescribed."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C062",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Major packaging redesign is unavailable within the decision period.",
      "scope": "The intervention options permitted by the mapping.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P038"}],
      "ambiguity": ""
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C063",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Evidence of leaks may warrant further investigation.",
      "scope": "A possible investigative response to leak evidence.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P038"}],
      "ambiguity": "The evidence threshold and form of further investigation are unspecified."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C064",
      "fields": ["limit"],
      "proposition": "Evidence of leaks does not imply that the permitted process change will resolve them.",
      "scope": "The remedial reach of the available fulfillment or communication intervention.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P038"}],
      "ambiguity": "The mapping does not establish that every permitted process change would be ineffective against leaks."
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C065",
      "fields": ["operation"],
      "proposition": "Inquiry into actual use, remaining stock, alternative purchases and service encounters should not presume dissatisfaction.",
      "scope": "Questioning participating customers.",
      "evidence_used": [{"source_id": "P007"}],
      "ambiguity": "No specific interview wording is prescribed."
    }
  ],
  "coverage": [
    {
      "field": "state",
      "claim_ids": ["C001", "C002", "C003", "C004", "C005", "C006", "C007"],
      "unrepresented_material": [],
      "rationale": "C001–C007 capture the calendar-anchor premise, possible reconstruction problems, proposed shared-pattern premise and two unestablished comparability assumptions. P001 supplies the working scope and inventory of recorded and reconstructed events for a limited consenting sample; it does not establish that complete histories are available. P003 prescribes sampling across purchase outcomes, fulfillment options, container types, discounts and acquisition periods without stating a separate sampling-effect proposition. These setup instructions are retained here rather than expanded into claims for each data item or sampling category."
    },
    {
      "field": "operation",
      "claim_ids": ["C008", "C009", "C010", "C011", "C012", "C013", "C014", "C015", "C017", "C018", "C019", "C020", "C021", "C022", "C023", "C024", "C025", "C026", "C027", "C028", "C029", "C065"],
      "unrepresented_material": [],
      "rationale": "The claims capture evidential distinctions, alignment restrictions and criteria, the example sequence, complementary temporal comparisons, corroboration requirements, stopping conditions, conditional intervention choices, trial evaluation prescriptions and the inconclusive-inquiry purchasing branch. P005 supplies routine first-week construction of a calendar-dated reference and separate weekly household sequences. P006 supplies the contact procedure: one voluntary invitation, an interview, optional agreed follow-up and no repeated contact with nonrespondents. These procedural details are not expanded into independent epistemic propositions. P007's inquiry inventory remains attached to its prohibition on presuming dissatisfaction."
    },
    {
      "field": "signal",
      "claim_ids": ["C013", "C014", "C015", "C016", "C018", "C030", "C031", "C032"],
      "unrepresented_material": [],
      "rationale": "The claims cover the proposed alignment signal, competing fits, both illustrative sequences, the need to corroborate apparent anomalies, trial observations and separation of participation and missing follow-up from outcomes. P021's qualification that the sequences are proposed observations rather than findings is preserved within C015 and C016. Examples of targeted steps and accompanying measurements remain within C030 rather than becoming separate findings. Routine instructions to look, observe and record do not supply additional conclusions."
    },
    {
      "field": "inference",
      "claim_ids": ["C033", "C034", "C035", "C036", "C037", "C038", "C039", "C040", "C041"],
      "unrepresented_material": [],
      "rationale": "The three distinct uses of a qualifying alignment are separated, followed by the limited household distinction, mechanism prioritization, restriction on explaining the overall decline, provisional trial decision, purchasing basis and later eight-week assessment. Conditions concerning distinctiveness, independent corroboration, credible comparison, tested groups and conditions, consent and elapsed cohort time remain attached to their propositions. The five-week deadline and purchasing inputs remain part of the decision prescription rather than separate factual findings."
    },
    {
      "field": "limit",
      "claim_ids": ["C042", "C043", "C044", "C045", "C046", "C047", "C048", "C049", "C050", "C051", "C052", "C053", "C054", "C055", "C056", "C057", "C058", "C059", "C060", "C061", "C062", "C063", "C064"],
      "unrepresented_material": [],
      "rationale": "The claims cover disruptions of shared patterns, distinct false-match risks, precision and overlap bounds, concurrent-change attribution, both potentially selective customer groups, all three satisfaction-proxy limitations, trial duration and comparison limitations, conditional stopping or revision, documentation, packaging availability and the two different implications of leak evidence. The disturbance inventory in P031 remains one shared-pattern limitation; its nouns are not promoted into independently demonstrated effects. Concurrent introduction of promotions and collection points remains the stated premise of C050. No material proposition from this field is left unrepresented."
    }
  ]
}
